Assert that the buyer’s counter offer was initiated.
Move to the invited vendor’s supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer should be visible to the vendor.
Confirm the vendor portal exposes the pending counter offer before the unsupported rejection action.
